Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 18 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 23 September 2025(Tuesday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac, Pampanga and Bulacan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Nueva Ecija, Batangas, Rizal, Laguna, Cavite and Metro Manila within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Quezon(Panukulan, Polillo, Burdeos, Patnanungan, Jomalig, Calauag, Lopez, Tagkawayan, Buenavista, Guinayangan, General Luna, Catanauan, Macalelon) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
